_note: OpenTelemetry GenAI compatibility matrix: the hand-kept source for docs/integrations/otel-genai-compatibility.md. Regenerate the page with `python scripts/otel_genai_matrix.py --write`; `--check` fails when the page or this file drifts. status is read, partial or not-read; uses names the per-check fields of scripts/rule_fields.py that the row feeds.

rows.name: chat
rows.how: Model call: its output feeds the per-response tool-call batches and step counts.
uses: OTel chat span gen_ai.output.messages (tool_call parts per response)

rows.name: generate_content
rows.how: Model call, read like `chat`.
uses: OTel chat span gen_ai.output.messages (tool_call parts per response)

rows.name: realtime_inference
rows.how: Model call, read like `chat` (new since 3.7.0).
uses: OTel chat span gen_ai.output.messages (tool_call parts per response)

rows.name: user_speech
rows.how: Kept in the span tree only.

rows.name: text_completion
rows.how: Model call, read like `chat`.
uses: OTel chat span gen_ai.output.messages (tool_call parts per response)

rows.name: embeddings
rows.how: Kept in the span tree only.

rows.name: retrieval
rows.how: Kept in the span tree only.

rows.name: fetch_response
rows.how: Not a model call; no content to judge.

rows.name: create_agent
rows.how: Agent creation is not a run step.

rows.name: invoke_agent
rows.how: Read as the root span or as an agent span in the tree (agent name, turn markers); a handoff needs `agentest.handoff.source`, or a transfer tool span.

rows.name: execute_tool
rows.how: A tool call: name, id, arguments, result and error state.

rows.name: invoke_workflow
rows.how: Read as an ordinary root or nested span; the workflow's name arrives as `gen_ai.agent.name` (the older `gen_ai.workflow.name` is mapped).

rows.name: invoke_runner
rows.how: Read as an ordinary root or nested span.

rows.name: plan
rows.how: Kept in the span tree; no check reads planning spans.

rows.name: search_memory
rows.how: Memory operations are kept in the span tree only.

rows.name: create_memory
rows.how: Memory operations are kept in the span tree only.

rows.name: update_memory
rows.how: Memory operations are kept in the span tree only.

rows.name: delete_memory_store
rows.how: Memory operations are kept in the span tree only.

rows.name: gen_ai.client.invoke_agent
rows.how: Agent span (client side): agent name and turn markers are read; no handoff without a source or transfer.

rows.name: gen_ai.invoke_agent.internal
rows.how: Agent span (in process), including `invoke_workflow` and `invoke_runner`: same reading as the client span.

rows.name: gen_ai.execute_tool
rows.how: Tool call span.

rows.name: gen_ai.plan.internal
rows.how: Kept in the span tree only.

rows.name: gen_ai.execute_tool.transfer
rows.how: Tool span with `gen_ai.transfer.target.name`: read as a tool call and as a handoff (new since 3.7.0).

rows.name: gen_ai.execute_tool.load_skill
rows.how: Read as a tool call; the `gen_ai.skill.*` attributes are not read.

rows.name: gen_ai.execute_tool.read_skill_resource
rows.how: Read as a tool call; the `gen_ai.skill.*` attributes are not read.

rows.name: gen_ai.execute_tool.command
rows.how: Read as a tool call; the `gen_ai.skill.*` and `process.*` attributes are not read.

rows.name: provider-specific refinements
rows.how: Provider refinements of the inference and fetch-response spans are read as model calls; their vendor-prefixed attributes are not read.

rows.name: gen_ai.client.inference.operation.details
rows.how: Content on this event (span event or log record) is merged onto its span when the span lacks it: input and output messages, system instructions, token counts (new since 3.7.0). Other attributes are ignored.

rows.name: gen_ai.evaluation.result
rows.how: Read from the root span, a child span or a log record; only `gen_ai.evaluation.score.label` is used by checks.

rows.name: gen_ai.client.inference.exception
rows.how: Not read; `error.type` and the span status mark a failed step.

rows.name: gen_ai.client.operation.exception
rows.how: Not read; `error.type` and the span status mark a failed step.

rows.name: gen_ai.client.embeddings.exception
rows.how: Not read.

rows.name: gen_ai.client.invoke_agent.exception
rows.how: Not read; `error.type` and the span status mark a failed step.

rows.name: gen_ai.invoke_agent.exception
rows.how: Not read; `error.type` and the span status mark a failed step.

rows.name: gen_ai.execute_tool.exception
rows.how: Not read; `error.type` and the span status mark a failed tool call.

rows.name: gen_ai.client.fetch_response.exception
rows.how: Not read.

rows.name: gen_ai.client.realtime_session.started
rows.how: Not read.

rows.name: gen_ai.client.realtime_session.ended
rows.how: Not read.

rows.name: text
rows.how: Text of the user input and of the answer.

rows.name: tool_call
rows.how: A model's tool request: becomes a tool call when no tool span has the id, and counts toward batches of calls in one response.
uses: OTel chat span gen_ai.output.messages (tool_call parts per response)

rows.name: tool_call_response
rows.how: Result of a tool request, joined to the call by id.

rows.name: gen_ai.operation.name
rows.how: Selects how the span is read (see the operation rows).

rows.name: gen_ai.tool.name
rows.how: Tool name; the span name `execute_tool {name}` is the fallback.

rows.name: gen_ai.tool.call.id
rows.how: Joins tool spans to `tool_call` and `tool_call_response` parts; no default check reads the id itself.

rows.name: gen_ai.tool.call.arguments
rows.how: Tool arguments, as a JSON string or a structured value.

rows.name: gen_ai.tool.call.result
rows.how: Tool result, as a JSON string or a structured value (a structured result is now kept as JSON, new since 3.7.0).

rows.name: gen_ai.input.messages
rows.how: User input and turn markers; as a JSON string, a structured value, or on an operation.details event.

rows.name: gen_ai.output.messages
rows.how: The answer and per-response tool calls; same three forms.

rows.name: gen_ai.agent.name
rows.how: Agent name: the actor of a tool call and the target of a handoff.

rows.name: gen_ai.conversation.id
rows.how: Groups runs into one multi-turn conversation.

rows.name: gen_ai.transfer.target.name
rows.how: Target of a transfer tool span, recorded as a handoff (new since 3.7.0).

rows.name: gen_ai.evaluation.score.label
rows.how: A `fail` or `incorrect` label is a failed success signal.

rows.name: error.type
rows.how: Marks a failed tool call or step (with the span status).
